invariants.rationale: The method logic assumes that the layer argument is not null, as it calls methods and accesses fields on layer.
The method accesses fields of batchColor (such as r, g, b, a), so batchColor is expected to be non-null.
The method accesses r, g, and b fields of the result of layer.getCombinedTintColor(), which implies it must be non-null.
Opacity for a layer is typically constrained to the [0,1] interval, as it is directly used in color calculation.
